5. Check each reservation: any portion already flown → cannot cancel, transfer to human agent.
6. Verify at least one cancellation condition holds (booked within last 24 hrs, airline cancelled, business cabin, or travel insurance covering the reason). If none hold, deny cancellation for that reservation.
7. Present cancellation details (reservation id, flights, refund path to original payment methods, 5–7 business days) and obtain explicit "yes" before calling the cancel API.
8. Do not offer compensation unless user explicitly asks; if asked, confirm facts and apply eligibility rules (silver/gold, insurance, or business).
